cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; A secluded river bathing pavilion with sunlit limestone steps and a wicker basket for towels — She sets her folded swimming robe on a warm ledge before checking the water temperature with her toes; a training gym with a heavy bag — standing; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — seated on a chair; A bamboo-slip conservation studio with shallow sorting trays — She matches a broken half of a wooden tally to its mate before tying the two halves together for storage; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — adjusts the height of the stand holding a microphone; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a wind-rippled desert dune trail — lying on her left side; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — standing close to a high shelf or line; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — kneeling on the ground; a small rural station with a wooden bench and a single platform — standing; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds her keepsake up beside her face
